claim_boundary: A pass supports a low-complexity coordinate field: the effective input-coordinate exponent varies smoothly with a Reynolds-like operating coordinate, and the integrated field improves cross-RPM mechanism collapse and few-probe transfer on untouched propeller families. It does not establish exact Reynolds-number theory, uniqueness of the coordinate, cross-domain generality, or general AI scientific discovery.

collapse.metric: For each RPM-run pair and coordinate, symmetrically interpolate CT and CP on overlapping coordinate support; normalize RMSE by pooled CT/CP ranges floored at 0.01; combine CT/CP by geometric mean; family score is median pair error.

coordinate_field.interpretation: The field is the integral of the learned local exponent law. Multiplicative coordinate constants are gauge and omitted.

development.five_fold_note: linear b_eff(log R) coefficient estimates stable across family-disjoint folds; quadratic extension gave negligible improvement
development.sources: 137 consumed UIUC V1/V2 development families plus 16 UIUC Volume4 families consumed only after v0.16 failure
development.volume4_postfailure_validation: rounded field vs fixed gamma -0.1 collapse median ratio 0.765780, win 0.875; vs plain J ratio 0.598880, win 1.0

holdout.prior_brand_exposure_note: One Aero-Naut dynamic file from an older UIUC volume had been inspected earlier for file-format validation; none of these Volume-3 measurement files were opened before this freeze.
holdout.source: UIUC Propeller Database Volume 3 Version 1 (2020-08-20), Aero-Naut CAM folding propellers

strong_diagnostic.posthoc_global_constant_gamma_oracle: After holdout reveal only, scan one globally shared constant gamma. The frozen nonlinear field passes this diagnostic only if its median collapse is no worse than the best posthoc constant-gamma model.

transfer.calibration_run: lower median run after metadata RPM sort
transfer.common_support: score only rows simultaneously inside field, fixed-control, and J-control calibration support
transfer.fit: fit CT and CP separately with degree-3 Chebyshev on exactly five input-selected calibration probes
